evidence_plan.requirement: Previously reported results on cue detection
Previously reported results on scope resolution

payload.reason: The evidence provides specific previously reported results related to cue detection and scope resolution, as well as comparisons between models and training methods.

claims.text: Substantial improvements over previously reported results were achieved, with at least 0.29 F1 points on cue detection and 4.27 F1 points on scope resolution.
XLNet consistently outperforms BERT and RoBERTa, which contrasts with results on other benchmark datasets.
Joint training on multiple datasets outperforms single dataset training by a significant margin.
